race.comment: HERALD ANGEL (1) talented mare who strips fitter for this. Was a month between runs when she sat up on the speed from the wide draw to finish a respectable second over 1526m at Lismore. Andrew Mallyon retains the ride and can get the upper hand from the low gate. VALOURI (2) another from the Matt Dunn yard close to her top third up. Dragged back from the sticky gate and warmed up late when sixth over 1400m at the Gold Coast. Doesn't have to improve much to play a leading role. HE IS THE KISS (8) returned to form with a fast finishing third over 1730m at the Gold Coast. Will go back again from the wide gate and savage the line. Each way. CLASS REVOLUTION (6) tongue-tie comes off and looking for this trip and further now. Caught the eye late with the 61.5kg when fourth over 1370m at Bowraville. Can take a hand in the finish.
